title: SAM CLI plugin context, schema 1
description: What SAM CLI resolves once and hands every plugin it launches, in the file named by SAM_CONTEXT_FILE. A plugin reads this instead of parsing the template, samconfig or SAM CLI's global options itself. Paths are native absolute paths for the host OS. Never carries a credential: a profile name and a region, which the plugin resolves through the AWS SDK. Within schema 1, fields are only ever ADDED, and optional; a plugin ignores fields it does not know.

path.description: The mount point that ran, e.g. ["dev", "up"]. Also in SAM_COMMAND_PATH, dot-joined.

project_root.description: The directory SAM CLI ran in.

template.description: The template SAM CLI read, if one was found.

profile.description: Also set as AWS_PROFILE in the plugin's environment.

stack_name.description: The deployed stack, from --stack-name or samconfig's deploy section.

executable.description: SAM CLI itself, argv-style, for a plugin that calls back (e.g. to build): the frozen binary, or the interpreter plus -m samcli.

container_runtime.description: The container engine SAM CLI itself would use, or null when none is reachable.

samconfig.description: This command's samconfig parameters (e.g. [default.dev_up.parameters]), with global parameters merged in. Keys are the plugin's own.

functions.description: Every function in the template's root stack.

physical_name.description: The deployed function's name: from the stack, else the template's literal FunctionName confirmed to exist; null when not deployed.

code_uri.description: Absolute source directory of a Zip function.

vpc.description: True when the function has a VpcConfig.
